text.en:
Defeating a Void-Debuffed (<bold Prismatic Only: Any Elementally Debuffed />) target grants <void/>Void Invisibility for 8 seconds (11 with <void/>Echo of Persistence) and <void/>Truesight for 4 seconds.

Activating Stylish Executioner incurs a <pve 2 /> <pvp [12] /> second cooldown.

While under the effect of <void/>Void Invisibility granted by <void/>Stylish Executioner, gain the following benefits for 0.? seconds after leaving Invisibility:
• <pve 300% /> <pvp [20%] /> Increased Melee Damage
• Melee applies <void/>Weaken for <pve 5 /> <pvp [2] /> seconds
• Melee Lunge Range is extended by ? meters

Powered Melee Abilities may benefit from this effect if they deal damage within the exit window.
